exposure: no occurrence of grade 3 placenta throughout pregnancy
outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: Patients were separated into three groups: those with grade 3 placenta diagnosed <36 weeks, those with grade 3 placenta diagnosed >36 weeks, and those with no occurrence of grade 3 placenta throughout pregnancy.
finding: Grade 3 placenta <36 weeks was significantly associated with a higher prevalence of adverse perinatal outcomes, including birth <37 weeks, birth weight <10th percentile, 5-min Apgar Score <7, NICU admission, fetal death, and pre-eclampsia.
